close_reason: Decision: exhaustive serialization test covers deprecated constructors. No code change needed.
description: The jmap_error_all_constructors_serialize test explicitly includes the deprecated unknown_capability() constructor rather than removing it when the deprecation was added. This is correct: the test's stated purpose is to guard the infallible-serialization invariant that error_invocation depends on. A deprecated constructor can still be called in the wild by code that hasn't migrated, and must serialize correctly. A future contributor might suggest removing the deprecated variant from the test to 'clean it up' — that would weaken the invariant guard.
title: Exhaustive serialization test covers deprecated constructors — correct strategy
